q: Can PFF's 'estimated' positions be trusted for officiating?
text:
No. Estimated positions fail the 5 m gate in all 10 games, so they should not be used for officiating decisions yet.
Estimated positions more than 5 m from the camera-based feed range from 24.4% (France v Australia) to 59.6% (Morocco v Croatia), against a limit of 5%.
Recommendation: Use only the visible-flag positions for officiating, and ask PFF to fix the estimated positions before they are used.
